tf_only.aws_ecr_account_setting: an account-level ECR setting (PutAccountSetting, e.g. default basic scan type); a preference on the account, not a distinct resource, and no CFN AWS::ECR account-settings type exists
tf_only.aws_ecs_account_setting_default: an account-level ECS default setting (PutAccountSettingDefault); a preference on the account, not a distinct resource
tf_only.aws_ecs_tag: attaches a single arbitrary tag to an existing ECS resource by ARN (TagResource); no cloud resource of its own
tf_only.aws_eip_domain_name: sets the reverse-DNS (PTR) domain name on an existing Elastic IP via ModifyAddressAttribute; AWS::EC2::EIP's CFN schema (Address/Domain/InstanceId/IpamPoolId/NetworkBorderGroup/PublicIpv4Pool/Tags/TransferAddress) has no such property, and no resource of its own
tf_only.aws_elasticsearch_domain_saml_options: reconfigures the SAML sub-block of an existing domain's fine-grained access control via UpdateElasticsearchDomainConfig; AWS::Elasticsearch::Domain's AdvancedSecurityOptionsInput schema (AnonymousAuthEnabled/Enabled/InternalUserDatabaseEnabled/MasterUserOptions) exposes no SAMLOptions, and this is not a resource of its own
tf_only.aws_emr_block_public_access_configuratio: an account/region-wide EMR security setting (PutBlockPublicAccessConfiguration), not a per-cluster resource; no distinct identity, no CFN model
tf_only.aws_fms_admin_account: designates the account-wide Firewall Manager administrator account (PutAdminAccount); an account-level singleton, no distinct resource identity, no CFN model
tf_only.aws_glacier_vault_lock: locks an existing Glacier vault's policy (InitiateVaultLock/CompleteVaultLock); the vault itself has no CFN model to fold under, and locking is a one-time state transition, not a separate resource
tf_only.aws_glue_resource_policy: the Glue Data Catalog's single account-wide resource policy (PutResourcePolicy); a singleton with no distinct identity, no CFN model
tf_only.aws_grafana_license_association: associates/disassociates a Grafana Enterprise license via a dedicated AssociateLicense/DisassociateLicense API; not any property of AWS::Grafana::Workspace's CFN schema
tf_only.aws_grafana_role_association: maps SSO users/groups to Grafana Admin/Editor roles via UpdatePermissions; not a Workspace property (distinct from the SAML-only RoleValues nested under SamlConfiguration)
tf_only.aws_grafana_workspace_api_key: issues a short-lived Grafana workspace API key/credential (CreateWorkspaceApiKey); not a persistent CFN-managed resource
tf_only.aws_grafana_workspace_service_account: creates a Grafana-internal service account inside the workspace; an application-level construct, not a CFN-modeled AWS resource of its own
tf_only.aws_grafana_workspace_service_account_to: issues a token for a workspace service account; an ephemeral credential revealed once, no persistent CFN resource
tf_only.aws_guardduty_member_detector_feature: toggles GuardDuty protection-plan features on a member account's detector from the admin account (UpdateMemberDetectors); not a property of the admin's own Detector resource, and AWS::GuardDuty::Member has no Features property
tf_only.aws_guardduty_organization_admin_account: designates the GuardDuty delegated administrator account org-wide (EnableOrganizationAdminAccount); a singleton, no CFN model
tf_only.aws_guardduty_organization_configuration: org-wide GuardDuty auto-enable configuration (UpdateOrganizationConfiguration); a singleton, no CFN model
org-wide GuardDuty auto-enable configuration, per protection-plan feature; a singleton, no CFN model
tf_only.aws_iam_account_alias: sets the account's IAM alias (CreateAccountAlias); an account-level singleton, no CFN model
tf_only.aws_iam_account_password_policy: the account-wide IAM password policy (UpdateAccountPasswordPolicy); a singleton, no CFN model
tf_only.aws_iam_group_policies_exclusive: authoritatively reconciles the complete set of inline policies on an existing IAM group; a declarative enforcer over another resource's state, not a resource with its own identity
tf_only.aws_iam_group_policy_attachments_exclusi: authoritatively reconciles the complete set of managed-policy attachments on an existing IAM group; a declarative enforcer over another resource's state, not a resource with its own identity
tf_only.aws_iam_organizations_features: enables IAM Organizations-wide features (centralized root credential management, etc.) via EnableAWSOrganizationsRootCredentialsManagement-style calls; a singleton, no CFN model
tf_only.aws_iam_policy_attachment: attaches one managed policy across an arbitrary combination of users/roles/groups in a single resource; spans multiple possible CFN parent types at once, so it has no single CFN parent and no distinct identity of its own
tf_only.aws_iam_role_policies_exclusive: authoritatively reconciles the complete set of inline policies on an existing IAM role; a declarative enforcer over another resource's state, not a resource with its own identity
tf_only.aws_iam_role_policy_attachments_exclusiv: authoritatively reconciles the complete set of managed-policy attachments on an existing IAM role; a declarative enforcer over another resource's state, not a resource with its own identity
tf_only.aws_iam_security_token_service_preferenc: sets the account's global STS endpoint token-version preference (SetSecurityTokenServicePreferences); a singleton, no CFN model
tf_only.aws_iam_user_policies_exclusive: authoritatively reconciles the complete set of inline policies on an existing IAM user; a declarative enforcer over another resource's state, not a resource with its own identity
tf_only.aws_iam_user_policy_attachments_exclusiv: authoritatively reconciles the complete set of managed-policy attachments on an existing IAM user; a declarative enforcer over another resource's state, not a resource with its own identity
tf_only.aws_inspector2_delegated_admin_account: designates the Inspector delegated administrator account org-wide (EnableDelegatedAdminAccount); a singleton, no CFN model
tf_only.aws_inspector2_enabler: enables Inspector scanning for specific resource types across accounts (BatchEnableMember-style call); not a distinct addressable resource
tf_only.aws_inspector2_organization_configuratio: org-wide Inspector auto-enable configuration (UpdateOrganizationConfiguration); a singleton, no CFN model
tf_only.aws_iot_event_configurations: an account/region-wide IoT event-type configuration singleton (UpdateEventConfigurations); no CFN model
tf_only.aws_iot_indexing_configuration: an account-wide IoT fleet-indexing configuration singleton (UpdateIndexingConfiguration); no CFN model
tf_only.aws_iot_logging_options: an account-wide IoT logging configuration singleton (SetV2LoggingOptions); no CFN model
tf_only.aws_iot_thing_group_membership: adds/removes an IoT thing from a thing group (AddThingToThingGroup); a dynamic relationship with no CFN AWS::IoT type of its own - ThingGroup and Thing are each modeled, but membership is neither a resource nor a property in either's CFN schema
tf_only.aws_kinesis_account_settings: the account-wide Kinesis Data Streams shard-limit settings (UpdateStreamLimits); a singleton, no CFN model
tf_only.aws_kms_ciphertext: a one-shot KMS Encrypt API call whose ciphertext result is stored in Terraform state; not a cloud resource
tf_only.aws_lakeformation_identity_center_config: the account-wide Lake Formation / IAM Identity Center integration configuration (CreateLakeFormationIdentityCenterConfiguration); a singleton, no CFN model
tf_only.aws_lakeformation_resource_lf_tags: manages the complete, authoritative set of LF-tags on a Data Catalog resource in one call (the successor to the singular resource_lf_tag); not a 1:1 mapping to a single AWS::LakeFormation::TagAssociation resource
tf_only.aws_lambda_function_recursion_config: toggles a Lambda function's recursive-invocation loop detection (PutFunctionRecursionConfig); not a property AWS::Lambda::Function's CFN schema exposes, no resource of its own
tf_only.aws_lambda_runtime_management_config: sets a function's runtime-version update mode (PutRuntimeManagementConfig - Auto/FunctionUpdate/Manual); not a property AWS::Lambda::Function's CFN schema exposes, no resource of its own

cfn_unmodeled.aws_elasticache_reserved_cache_node: a purchased ElastiCache reservation (PurchaseReservedCacheNodesOffering); a real, billed resource with its own ReservedCacheNodeId, but no AWS::ElastiCache reservation type is in the CFN registry
cfn_unmodeled.aws_elasticsearch_vpc_endpoint: an Elasticsearch/OpenSearch VPC endpoint (cross-account PrivateLink-style access) with its own VpcEndpointId; not modeled by any AWS::Elasticsearch or AWS::OpenSearchService type in the registry
cfn_unmodeled.aws_elastictranscoder_pipeline: an Elastic Transcoder pipeline; a real, addressable resource (PipelineId/Arn), but the CFN registry has zero AWS::ElasticTranscoder types at all
cfn_unmodeled.aws_elastictranscoder_preset: an Elastic Transcoder preset; a real, addressable resource (PresetId/Arn), but the CFN registry has zero AWS::ElasticTranscoder types at all
cfn_unmodeled.aws_emrcontainers_job_template: an EMR-on-EKS job template, addressable via its own JobTemplateId/Arn; CFN's EMRContainers coverage (Endpoint/SecurityConfiguration/VirtualCluster) has no JobTemplate type
cfn_unmodeled.aws_finspace_kx_cluster: a FinSpace Managed kdb+ (Kx) cluster; CFN's FinSpace coverage is only AWS::FinSpace::Environment (the legacy FinSpace platform), with no Kx sub-resources modeled at all
cfn_unmodeled.aws_finspace_kx_database: a FinSpace Managed kdb+ (Kx) database; not modeled by CFN's sole AWS::FinSpace::Environment type
cfn_unmodeled.aws_finspace_kx_dataview: a FinSpace Managed kdb+ (Kx) dataview; not modeled by CFN's sole AWS::FinSpace::Environment type
cfn_unmodeled.aws_finspace_kx_environment: a FinSpace Managed kdb+ (Kx) environment - a distinct resource from the modeled AWS::FinSpace::Environment (the legacy FinSpace platform), created via the separate CreateKxEnvironment API; not itself a CFN type
cfn_unmodeled.aws_finspace_kx_scaling_group: a FinSpace Managed kdb+ (Kx) scaling group; not modeled by CFN's sole AWS::FinSpace::Environment type
cfn_unmodeled.aws_finspace_kx_user: a FinSpace Managed kdb+ (Kx) user; not modeled by CFN's sole AWS::FinSpace::Environment type
cfn_unmodeled.aws_finspace_kx_volume: a FinSpace Managed kdb+ (Kx) volume; not modeled by CFN's sole AWS::FinSpace::Environment type
cfn_unmodeled.aws_fsx_backup: an FSx backup with its own BackupId/Arn; no AWS::FSx::Backup type is in the CFN registry (only FileSystem/Volume/Snapshot/StorageVirtualMachine/DataRepositoryAssociation/S3AccessPointAttachment are modeled)
cfn_unmodeled.aws_fsx_file_cache: an FSx File Cache with its own FileCacheId/Arn; not present among the CFN registry's FSx types
cfn_unmodeled.aws_glacier_vault: a Glacier vault with its own VaultARN; the CFN registry has zero AWS::Glacier types
cfn_unmodeled.aws_globalaccelerator_custom_routing_acc: a Global Accelerator custom-routing accelerator; CFN's GlobalAccelerator types (Accelerator/CrossAccountAttachment/EndpointGroup/Listener) are all standard-routing only, with no CustomRouting* types
cfn_unmodeled.aws_globalaccelerator_custom_routing_end: a Global Accelerator custom-routing endpoint group; not modeled by any CFN GlobalAccelerator type
cfn_unmodeled.aws_globalaccelerator_custom_routing_lis: a Global Accelerator custom-routing listener; not modeled by any CFN GlobalAccelerator type
cfn_unmodeled.aws_glue_partition_index: a Glue partition index (CreatePartitionIndex), with its own IndexName; AWS::Glue::Partition's schema (CatalogId/DatabaseName/PartitionInput/TableName) has no index-list property, and no separate PartitionIndex CFN type exists
cfn_unmodeled.aws_iam_service_specific_credential: a service-specific credential (e.g. CodeCommit git credentials) with its own ServiceSpecificCredentialId; real and addressable, but CFN's IAM types include AccessKey, not this credential kind
cfn_unmodeled.aws_iam_signing_certificate: an uploaded X.509 signing certificate for a user, with its own CertificateId; no CFN IAM type models it
cfn_unmodeled.aws_iam_user_ssh_key: an uploaded SSH public key for CodeCommit, with its own SSHPublicKeyId; no CFN IAM type models it
cfn_unmodeled.aws_identitystore_user: an IAM Identity Center identity-store user with its own UserId; CFN's IdentityStore coverage is Group/GroupMembership only, no User type
cfn_unmodeled.aws_inspector2_member_association: associates a member account with the Inspector delegated admin (mirroring AWS::GuardDuty::Member's concept); CFN's InspectorV2 types (Filter/CisScanConfiguration/CodeSecurityIntegration/CodeSecurityScanConfiguration) have no Member-equivalent type
cfn_unmodeled.aws_kendra_experience: a Kendra Experience (search UI) with its own Id/Arn; CFN's Kendra types are DataSource/Faq/Index only
cfn_unmodeled.aws_kendra_query_suggestions_block_list: a Kendra query-suggestions block list, a real resource with its own Id; not modeled by CFN's Kendra types
cfn_unmodeled.aws_kendra_thesaurus: a Kendra thesaurus, a real resource with its own Id; not modeled by CFN's Kendra types
cfn_unmodeled.aws_kinesisanalyticsv2_application_snaps: a Kinesis Data Analytics v2 application snapshot with its own SnapshotName; CFN's KinesisAnalyticsV2 types (Application/ApplicationCloudWatchLoggingOption/ApplicationOutput/ApplicationReferenceDataSource) do not include Snapshot
cfn_unmodeled.aws_kms_custom_key_store: a KMS custom key store (CloudHSM- or XKS-backed) with its own CustomKeyStoreId; not modeled by any CFN KMS type
cfn_unmodeled.aws_kms_grant: a KMS grant with its own GrantId; not modeled by any CFN KMS type
cfn_unmodeled.aws_kms_replica_external_key: a multi-Region replica of an externally-sourced KMS key; AWS::KMS::ReplicaKey's schema (Description/Enabled/KeyPolicy/PendingWindowInDays/PrimaryKeyArn/Tags) has no key-material-import support, so an EXTERNAL-origin replica is not representable
cfn_unmodeled.aws_lakeformation_lf_tag_expression: a saved LF-tag expression (a named boolean combination of LF-tags) with its own name; not among CFN's LakeFormation types (DataCellsFilter/DataLakeSettings/Permissions/PrincipalPermissions/Resource/Tag/TagAssociation)
cfn_unmodeled.aws_lakeformation_opt_in: opts a principal+resource pair into Lake Formation's hybrid access mode; addressable via ListLakeFormationOptIns with its own identity, not modeled by any CFN LakeFormation type
